div.div: سُبْتٌ A certain plant, resembling the خِطْمِىّ [or marsh-mallow]; (Kr, M, K;) as also ↓ سَبْتٌ , (K [there expressly said to be with fet-h],) or ↓ سِبْتٌ : (M [so written in a copy of that work]:) said to be a certain plant used for tanning. (MF.) See the next paragraph.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
